raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.9.1"

package:
  name: libm2k
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/libm2k/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f9a78a8573cc2781d7787e89eebbf9e4efd88e978afdb7be78dbe6b4a00d10a6
  patches:
    - 0001-Query-Python-EXT_SUFFIX-to-set-the-extension-suffix.patch
    - 0002-cmake-Don-t-set-CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH.patch

build:
  number: 1

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake <4
    - ninja
    - swig
    # cross-compilation requirements
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - libiio
    # Since Python 3.15, library is split into libpython output needed by CMake
    - libpython
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    # libiio run dep included by its run_exports
    - python
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("libm2k", upper_bound="x.x") }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    from_package:
      # CMake needs to find libpython, but it is not linked to except on linux
      - if: not linux
        then: libpython

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      bin:
        - m2kcli
      include:
        - libm2k/m2k.hpp
        - libm2k/**
      lib:
        - if: unix
          then: m2k
      files:
        - ${{ "Lib/" if (win and match(python, "<3.15")) else "lib/python*" }}site-packages/*libm2k*
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/cmake/libm2k/*.cmake
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/pkgconfig/libm2k.pc
        - if: linux
          then: lib/udev/rules.d/53-adi-m2k-usb.rules
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/libm2k.dll
            - Library/lib/libm2k.lib
  - python:
      imports:
        - libm2k
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - m2kcli --help

about:
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Library for interfacing with the ADALM2000
  description: |
    C++ library and python bindings for interfacing with
    the ADALM2000 portable lab. This library simplifies
    ADALM2000's functionality into a series of easy to
    use components.
  homepage: https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/libm2k
  repository: https://github.com/analogdevicesinc/libm2k
  documentation: https://analogdevicesinc.github.io/libm2k/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ryanvolz
    - tfcollins
